work.description: An English translation, edited by Patrick Laurence Murphy of St Patrick's College, Manly (later auxiliary bishop in Sydney and first bishop of Broken Bay), of the 1960 code of rubrics with John XXIII's apostolic letter and the decree of the Sacred Congregation of Rites, followed by a practical commentary. The preface records that Father C. B. O'Donoghue translated part. The translation is a secondary witness to the Latin code, which controls.
